notes.title: Demo Update #3
notes.notes:
User Interface Fixes 


 Changed the "Follow" to "Call" on the UI to better reflect it's feature. 
 Moved the Steam overlay to the co-op 2 player selection screen.


 

Gameplay Fixes 


 Fixed audio bug with the sub grabbing batteries.
 Added voiceover skip.
 Removed the ability to drop tools.

notes.title: Demo Build Update #2
notes.notes:
User Interface Fixes 


 Increased the amount of time captions remain on the screen. 
 Added an initial caption to rremind players to examine the mini map.
 Mini map icons are removed when objective is completed. 
 Added a new task on Chapter 3 to help guide players.
 Updated a task on Chapter 3 to help guide players.


 

Gameplay Fixes 


 Added voice Lines to assist players with shark encounters.
 Added some extra lights on Chapter 3.
 Fixed Textures on Chapter 2.
 Increased the brightness on battery inserts.
 Increased the brightness on the fuse.
 Adjusted the access card.
 Fixed a bug in Chapter 1 where sprinting would cut the captions short.
 Fixed a sun spot.

notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes for October 3, 2024
notes.notes:
User Interface Fixes 


 Increased “out of bounds” timer to give players more time to turn around. 
 Reduced tutorial text to better explain controls for character swaps. 
 Added an initial caption to remind players to consistently monitor oxygen levels.
 Added a tip to inform players on how to see current objectives.
 Added a tip to teach players about tools.
 Completed objectives now disappear off the mini-map.
 Task drawer time increased.
 Fixed “ascend” and “descend” controls layout for the submersible.


 

Gameplay Fixes 


 Fixed death animations when dying “out of bounds”.
 Fixed collider issue with a fuse and the wall. 
 Fixed pathing on the shark to give extra time. 
 Fixed collision/clip-through issue with the wall in Chapter 3.
 Heartbeat radius increased for megalodon when outside the facility. 


 

Hardware Fixes 


 For controllers, fixed a never-ending vibration after stage completion.

notes.title: Demo Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We at Favor Games would like to take the time to personally thank each and every single one of you for entrusting us with your entertainment experience! We are incredibly excited to present our demo to the public for you to enjoy and provide your valuable feedback! 

The current demo will allow you to play through the end of Chapter three, at which point we hope that you have managed to begin forming an opinion of the game. As time goes on, and the game is released in the next few months, we hope that experiencing this piece of the journey will provide you with the desire to continue the story and enjoy your time throughout. 

We will be working diligently to address any and all issues that may be pointed out to us through this, and we again cannot thank you enough for your faith in us, our game, and the future that this will create for all of us as players and developers alike. Feel free to leave any and all issues, compliments, suggestions, or complaints for us to review and use to improve the player experience. 


The Favor Games Team
